message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians (in most provinces) will enjoy in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, or a holiday that is observed on a weekday adjacent to a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **April 7 – 9** | Good Friday (and Easter Saturday/Sunday) | Fri‑Sat‑Sun | ✔ | Observed in most provinces (except a few like Quebec). |
| **May 19 – 22** | Victoria Day (Mon May 22) | Fri‑Sat‑Sun‑Mon | ✔ | National holiday; always on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **September 1 – 4** | Labour Day (Mon Sep 4) | Fri‑Sat‑Sun‑Mon | ✔ | First Monday in September. |
| **October 6 – 9** | Thanksgiving (Mon Oct 9) | Fri‑Sat‑Sun‑Mon | ✔ | Second Monday in October. |
| **November 10 – 13** | Remembrance Day (Fri Nov 11) | Fri‑Sat‑Sun | ✔ | Observed in many provinces; some observe on the nearest weekday if it falls on a weekend. |
| **December 22 – 25** | Christmas (Mon Dec 25) | Fri‑Sat‑Sun‑Mon | ✔ | Christmas Day is a statutory holiday; Boxing Day (Dec 26) is a holiday in some provinces but does not create a long weekend. |

### Holidays that fall on a weekend (no extra long weekend)

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 2** | New Year’s Day (Sun Jan 1) | Sun‑Mon | No long weekend. |
| **July 1 – 2** | Canada Day (Sat Jul 1) | Sat‑Sun | No long weekend. |
| **Dec 25 – 26** | Boxing Day (Tue Dec 26) | Tue | Not a long weekend. |

> **Pro‑Tip:** Some provinces have additional holidays that can create extra long weekends (e.g., Family Day on Feb 20 in Ontario, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). Check your provincial government’s holiday calendar for the full list.

**Sources**  
- Government of Canada – *Public holidays* (https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/public-pensions.html)  
- Provincial government holiday pages (e.g., Ontario: https://www.ontario.ca/page/public-holidays)

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific details, let me know.
